vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate defaults this to null for security fixes.

customManagers.description: The Renovate image the renovate-config workflow validates this file with.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once every check is green. platformAutomerge is off because main has no required status checks, so GitHub would merge before CI finishes. Not digest: a re-pointed tag keeps its old release date, so it skips minimumReleaseAge.
CI never runs web-ext, so green CI says nothing about a web-ext bump.
Renovate publishes several times a day; bump the validator image weekly.
mise releases almost daily, some with breaking changes, and each bump misses the CI tool cache; bump it weekly.
Raise an engines ceiling only after CI is green on the new major (see docs/toolchain.md); a major bump of the exact pin fails install until then.
Override targets are advisory floors, each on a chosen major. They move when an advisory does, not when a release lands (see docs/toolchain.md).
